cards.label: A message from Archie
cards.text: You've been moving product. It's working. Archie's text simply says: "good output. call me."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "So the consumables are going well. Got a buyer asking for more pearls and asking if there's anything else on offer. Which made me think — can you make anything else?"

cards.speaker: You
cards.text: "Not yet. James only taught me the pearls."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Yeah. Right. See, James knows how to make about forty different things and he's sitting on all of it. Which is his prerogative, obviously. But I'm thinking — have you got any sort of relationship with him yet? Because it might be worth asking."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Gently. James doesn't respond well to being asked for things directly. Try framing it as being useful to him. Which, actually, you could be — if he's got orders he can't fill, you could take the overflow. Might be the angle."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Worth a try anyway. He's the only craftsman I know who isn't either retired or in prison, so options are limited."
He hangs up before you can ask anything else. You look up James's address in your phone.

on_complete.text: Overflow work, if you're capable of it. Come by.
